'''Hizram Riean''' was a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].

==Biography==
Sometime following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] working for [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] led [[Romo Vax]] to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]]. Unbeknownst to the spacer however, Romo was being pursued by Hizram Riean, a ruthless bounty hunter. Bib Fortuna, not amused by these turn of events, gave the spacer one chance to find and eliminate the bounty hunter before he reached Romo Vax. Not wishing to face [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba's]] wrath, the spacer agreed to the task.

By now, Hizram Riean and two of his thugs were already nearing Jabba's Palace. Yet the spacer reached them in time, and managed to eliminate both thugs, as well as Hizram.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateBountyHunter.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Hizram Riean]]
Hizram Riean was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the
[[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was part of a series of quests, collectively referred to as "Jabba's Themepark." Bib Fortuna would task players with killing Hizram, before he reached [[Romo Vax]]. Ultimately, Hizram Riean was removed from the game when "Jabba's Themepark" underwent a drastic overhaul during the so-called "New Game Enhancements" of [[2005]].
